item.tib: zhi khro sman gsum gyi lag len gsal byed
item.coloph: de ltar zhi khro sman gsum gyi zin bris mkhyer bde 'di/ bla ma bka' drin can gyi (gyis) gsungs bskul ngor/ mkhas grub tshe dbang rnam 'od rnam gnyis kyi phyag len gyi yig cha dang / bstan 'gro'i bsod nams bstan rgyal gyi dgongs bzhed rnams yid la bcag pa rgyal ba gtsug phud kyi (kyis) khri brtan nor rtse'i rab gsal du bris pa 'dis kyang / sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan tshugs par gyur cig/
